▶️…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @eslahatnews

📢 The JCPOA is still a factor in the Security Council's calculations

▶️ The newspaper "Sazandegi" reported that despite the political weakening of the JCPOA and the expiration of the timeframe stipulated in Resolution 2231, the legal ramifications of the agreement are still evident in disputes over Iran's nuclear file.

▶️ According to Sazandegi, Russia and China on Thursday vetoed a US-proposed resolution to extend the mandate of the Panel of Experts on Iran sanctions, citing the legal framework established after the 2015 nuclear deal and Resolution 2231.

▶️ Moscow and Beijing argue that the process for reimposing and implementing Security Council sanctions must align with the provisions and timeframes set out in Resolution 2231 — an interpretation that puts them at odds with the US and European countries.

▶️ Sazandegi concluded that although the JCPOA has been severely weakened politically, its legal legacy remains a central point of contention among major powers over the Iran file.

_Islahat News ✅ @Eslahatnews
🔗 Eslahatnews.com

📝 Netanyahu: We will overthrow the Iranian regime

Netanyahu at the "Ceremony Honoring the Outstanding Figures and Elite Forces of Israel's Internal Security Organization (Shabak / Shin Bet)" on the occasion of the upcoming Hebrew New Year (Rosh Hashanah):

"In Judea and Samaria (the West Bank), 1,000 thwarting operations were carried out; meaning 1,000 attempts to massacre our people were foiled, and these achievements are truly amazing and extraordinary. These successes have been achieved thanks to your efforts and comprehensive coordination with the Israel Defense Forces and all security institutions.

In the Gaza Strip as well, we are witnessing an event that I believe has astonished everyone. We entered Gaza and are inflicting heavy blows on Hamas; while it was said that Hamas would remain immune and invulnerable, the exact opposite has occurred.

We are also settling accounts with the perpetrators and murderers who killed our sons, daughters, spouses, and children on October 7. We are settling accounts precisely with their survivors; and of course, not many of them remain, because we are taking care of them. When we tell the terrorists 'no one is immune and our reach extends to all of you,' it is you who implement this in practice.

The enemy is not static and conditions change. The motivation to destroy the State of Israel by Iran and its proxy forces has not disappeared, but has weakened; its ability to realize it in a highly devastating manner has been shattered. We have advanced most of the work, but there are still tasks that must be completed.

And we will complete it: we will destroy Hamas; first and foremost, we will defeat the Iranian regime, we will overthrow it and it will fall; and we will also settle accounts with Hezbollah and it too will collapse.

Relying on what you did in Judea and Samaria, relying on what you did in the Gaza Strip, both the things you did in the past and what you are doing now in these two regions, and relying on your pioneering actions in the field of technology, I know that you have a brilliant performance; the elites and outstanding figures of Israel's General Security Service (Shabak). You lead a steadfast, powerful, committed, and above all, successful force.

Thank you very much. Happy New Year to us; have a good year."

entry.title: [VahidOnline] On Thursday, 26 Shahrivar, Russia and China vetoed a U.S.-proposed draft…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @VahidOnline

On Thursday, 26 Shahrivar, Russia and China vetoed a U.S.-proposed draft resolution at the United Nations Security Council that sought to extend the mandate of the expert panel of the 1737 Sanctions Committee against the Islamic Republic of Iran. The meeting was convened at the initiative of France, which holds the Security Council's rotating presidency in September, under the agenda item "non-proliferation." In the vote among the Council's 15 members, the resolution received 11 votes in favor but faced explicit opposition (veto) from Moscow and Beijing, along with abstentions from Pakistan and Somalia. For a resolution to pass in the Council, in addition to securing at least 9 votes in favor, none of the permanent members must veto it. Diplomats had previously reported that Russia and China were firmly opposed to the plan. Moscow and Beijing believe that with the definitive expiration of Resolution 2231 of the JCPOA in October 2025, all previous sanctions mechanisms, including Committee 1737, have no validity or legal effect.@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline

🔸 The news…

Source: @Kayhan_online

🔰 The "Oman Trap" Sanitized by the Government News Agency!

🔸 The news coverage and analysis of recent diplomatic maneuvers has once again laid bare the dangerous naivety of certain domestic factions in the face of the complex designs of the Western-Arab front.

🔸 At a time when the sudden cancellation or postponement of the Salalah meeting in Oman — at America's direct dictation to Riyadh and its allies — proved that these meetings are not meant for convergence, but are rather a pre-planned trap to "blunt the sharp edge of Iran's weapon, namely its authority over the Strait of Hormuz," the strange insistence and eagerness of the "government news agency" to once again pave the way for this snare is deeply worthy of reflection.

🔸 The government news agency, in a piece penned by one of its former diplomats, ignoring the hostile nature of the other side's game, has claimed: "Fortunately, the formation of this meeting... is the demand of all Persian Gulf regional countries, and it has been postponed, not suspended; therefore, the likelihood of this meeting being held is very high." This passive approach is being pumped out while numerous historical experiences have shown that retreating from Iran's leverage tools in the Persian Gulf only makes the Western side more brazen in its hostile designs.

🔸 The author of this piece, which has been republished in the official government media, ignoring the conspiratorial nature of the cancellation of this meeting, insists that "to achieve this goal, holding the summit in Oman is a vital necessity, and these countries are advised to arrange for its formation as soon as possible, because it is a new opportunity."

entry.summary:

Source: @VahidOnline

Oman's Foreign Minister announced the postponement of a meeting between Iran and the Persian Gulf and regional countries — a meeting that was set to be held on Monday, 23 Shahrivar, in Salalah, Oman, focusing on the situation in the Strait of Hormuz. Badr Al-Busaidi, Oman's Foreign Minister, wrote on Sunday, 22 Shahrivar, on X that the meeting was postponed "in order to reach consensus." He stressed that Oman remains committed to strengthening dialogues that contribute to "sustainable stability and cooperation in the region." Abbas Araghchi, the Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic, had previously said he would attend the eight-party meeting of foreign ministers from the coastal countries of the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman in Salalah on Monday. The meeting was supposed to discuss a plan by Iran and Oman to establish a mechanism for the safe passage of ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The postponement comes as the United States had previously emphasized that it would not take part in negotiations related to the Strait of Hormuz and would focus any direct talks with the Islamic Republic on the nuclear file. American officials have told regional countries that Washington will not negotiate over the situation in the Strait of Hormuz, and that the main subject of any potential negotiations with Tehran should be the Islamic Republic's nuclear program. Marco Rubio, the U.S. Secretary of State, had also previously said that the Strait of Hormuz should not be under the control of the Islamic Republic, and that the United States would act to guarantee the security of shipping along this route. In contrast, the Islamic Republic and Oman have sought to bring regional countries into dialogue about a mechanism for ship passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The results of Tehran and Muscat's consultations on safe shipping routes were supposed to be presented to the regional countries at this meeting. @VahidHeadline 📡 @VahidOnline
